scope: Independent read-only review and contingency reasoning; not benchmark results
correctness: No blocking defect found in exact clipped Gaussian moments, cross-action quadratic factors, zero-sigma point queries, actor gradients, inverse-LAP compensation, or behavior-cached lambda bootstrap refresh.
interpretation_limits: Exact integration is an architectural identity, not evidence of action-value accuracy.

Verified architecture confound: v21 retains encoder training and zs state features but removes Q's action-conditioned zsa input. Learned action dynamics no longer directly inform Q or its actor-facing derivatives.
Prefit score residuals measure average mismatch against bootstrapped labels, not state-specific or actor-parameter gradient accuracy.
Scale scores are derivatives with respect to sigma, not log-sigma.
Postfit labels, representation and bounds depend on fitting. Postfit diagnostics are not an independent accuracy oracle.
Prefit and postfit point MSE use different refreshed labels; their difference is not a paired accuracy improvement.
Horizon-block standard errors are descriptive because episode and bootstrap dependence can persist across blocks.

failure_contingency.hypothesis: Narrow on-policy samples fail to identify action credit even when distribution queries are internally consistent.
failure_contingency.diagnostic: Freeze continuation and bootstrap snapshots. Clone complete MuJoCo state into isolated branch data. Perturb the initial behavior mean in opposite directions along a predicted improvement direction, sharing initial and future Gaussian innovations. Compare paired 32-step lambda target contrast with analytic distribution-value contrast, including executed clipping.
failure_contingency.training_candidate: Antithetic initial actions with shared future innovations supply paired return contrasts. Regress predicted point-value differences against those contrasts so the state-value intercept cannot absorb the action evidence.
failure_contingency.accounting: Count every branch physics transition toward the 8M interaction budget. Preserve episode age, termination and truncation semantics. Do not alter live native environments or use qpos/qvel-only restoration.
failure_contingency.falsification: Poor paired covariance or continued held-out contrast error would reject the intended noise cancellation or action identification benefit.

low_cost_noise_diagnostic.control: Future-only recursive innovation q_snapshot(s,a) minus its exact behavior-policy expectation, evaluated with a critic snapshot fixed before collection.
low_cost_noise_diagnostic.difference_from_failed_v18: Uses the full nonlinear action function and exact clipped expectation rather than a truncated Hermite control.
low_cost_noise_diagnostic.cautions: Center the innovation with the unclamped expectation even when the bootstrap is clamped; stop recursion at segment and episode boundaries; never include the current action control. Measure covariance and variance on paired samples before deploying. Prior negligible Hermite covariance lowers confidence in a large gain.
low_cost_noise_diagnostic.priority: Diagnostic opportunity, not authorization to launch another uncalibrated control-variate variant.
